title: How a niche copper trade became a real-time gauge of Trump’s next tariff move
summary: The article discusses how fluctuations in copper prices across different metal exchanges are becoming a significant indicator of potential U.S. tariff changes under the Trump administration. Investors are closely monitoring these price movements to assess the risks associated with tariffs. This niche copper trade reflects broader economic sentiments and the complexities of international trade policies, particularly in the context of ongoing trade tensions.
shadowing: The widening price of copper is significant.
Investors are looking for gauges of tariff risk.
Real-time data is crucial for investment decisions.
